_comment: Local, versioned snapshot of the AlphaLive-facing export contract (StrategyExportSchema, schema_version 1.0), maintained entirely on the AlphaLab side - no AlphaLive code or schemas are copied here. This exists so tests/test_local_export_contract.py has an always-running local safeguard against export-contract drift, independent of whether AlphaLive is checked out as a sibling repo (test_schema_contract.py skips when it isn't - see that file's module docstring). This is deliberately narrower than the live cross-repo test: it only checks that AlphaLab's own StrategyExportSchema still produces the shape recorded here, not that AlphaLive still agrees with it.
provenance: Authoritative reference this fixture is CROSS-CHECKED against (not copied from): AlphaLive's alphalive/strategy_schema.py (StrategySchema, schema_version Literal['1.0']), read directly from the sibling checkout at /Alpha/AlphaLive during this pass. Verified 2026-09-12: AlphaLive's Risk/Execution/SafetyLimits/Metadata/BacktestPeriod field sets and schema_version literal match this fixture's top_level_required_fields/risk_fields/execution_fields/safety_limits_fields/metadata_fields exactly; for all 7 exportable strategies, AlphaLab's real final export field set (post StrategyExportSchema.model_validate()+model_dump(), not the pre-validation dict) is a strict subset of what AlphaLive's own extra='forbid' per-strategy Params models declare, confirmed by direct comparison - so nothing AlphaLab currently exports would be rejected as an unrecognized field by AlphaLive. AlphaLive declares a few AlphaLive-only optional fields with defaults that AlphaLab never populates (rsi_mean_reversion's `period`, momentum_breakout's `atr_period`, bollinger_breakout's `volume_ma_period`) - documented, non-breaking, and already covered by backend/tests/test_schema_contract.py's per-strategy live_only exceptions. Updating this fixture without re-reading AlphaLive's current strategy_schema.py first is not a real refresh, it's just editing a number.
scope_boundary: This fixture (and test_local_export_contract.py) protects STRUCTURE ONLY: field names, nesting, types, aliases, strategy identifiers, schema_version. It proves nothing about whether AlphaLive's signal_engine.py would compute the same trading signals from an accepted export, and nothing about future AlphaLive schema changes made after the provenance date above - see the cross-repo tests (backend/tests/test_schema_contract.py, AlphaLive/tests/test_multi_ticker_parity.py) for the narrower and different claims those make.
refresh_policy: Bump contract_version (and this file's name/backup) only alongside a deliberate schema_version change in backend/strategy_schema.py, or when a strategy's exported parameter field set changes on purpose (e.g. a new export-mapping alias in _translate_params_for_export). Any other diff here is a real, unintended drift and the test should fail, not be updated to match. Any refresh must re-read AlphaLive's current alphalive/strategy_schema.py (when available as a sibling checkout) and update the provenance note above with the date and what was re-verified - never bump contract_version off AlphaLab's own output alone.

rsi_mean_reversion._note: cooldown_days is NOT in the final exported strategy.parameters block - AlphaLab's own RSIMeanReversionParams export model (strategy_schema.py) never declared that field, so Pydantic's model_validate()+model_dump() step drops it (default extra='ignore'). The backtested value isn't lost: it already flows into the top-level execution.cooldown_bars field via _build_export_json, independent of this per-strategy parameters block. bb_period/bb_std (20, 2.0) appear instead - schema defaults, not real tunable params RSIMeanReversion accepts (FeatureEngineer's Bollinger Bands are fixed at 20/2.0 for every strategy, not configurable per-instance) - they're coincidentally correct, not backtested. Confirmed 2026-09-12 by diffing _build_export_json's raw dict against StrategyExportSchema.model_validate(...).model_dump(...)'s actual output - this fixture now records the real, final export, not the pre-validation intermediate.

rejected_strategies.rsi_simple: research/backtest-only - not in AlphaLive's deployable strategy set
rejected_strategies.vwap_reversion: requires an intraday timeframe AlphaLab cannot fetch (1Day/1Week/1Month only)
